Needs changes before merge. One functional finding requires `needs-rework`.

Reviewed the whole diff locally against current upstream rules. The trial merge uses upstream/main `d4601c6ea11653041a2c78352c46c4e1cd177513`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P3] Check the stored tool for the Apply holder refusal.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/model.rs:165`, consumed by `assembly_group.rs:76`: `draft_body` checks `k.tool`, which comes from the unapplied tool draft. However, `SetToolBody::library` checks the stored tool. These values can differ while the user edits this tab. For example, keep the stored flute length at 15 mm. Change the draft flute length to 5 mm without Apply. Choose ER20 chuck and set projection to 10 mm. The preview check accepts this draft and shows no refusal, but Apply holder refuses the stored tool because the holder reaches into its flutes. The reverse occurs with draft flute length 25 mm and projection 20 mm: the message says Apply holder refuses, but the command accepts the stored 15 mm flutes. Compute the command refusal from `editor_stored_tool()`. Keep any draft-preview diagnostic separate. Add regression tests for both directions. This finding follows the input paths in the code; the existing tests do not cover unapplied flute edits.

What looks good:

- Apply holder still uses the existing undoable command and its safety checks.
- The five new tests pass. They cover undo, refusals, projection reseeding, and separate window drafts.
- The before/after screenshot links load. No snapshot PNG or recorded program changed.
- The deferred surface moves have a decision entry and follow-up #3930.

Fix for the P3 finding of the review on `28fc33a2a` (Apply holder refusal judged on the draft tool).

Commit `9af86ad9f` closes this finding. The new head is `9af86ad9f`. It waits for a fresh review.

The fix:
- `tool_library_dialog/model.rs`: the preview model now takes `holder_err` from the stored tool (`Key::doc`, the same tool as `editor_stored_tool()`). `SetToolBody::library` uses this tool too.
- The verdict on the unapplied draft numbers is now a separate field, `draft_err`. It is set only when it differs from the Apply holder verdict.
- `assembly_group.rs` shows `draft_err` as a separate warning that starts with "Draft note: the unapplied tool numbers do not take this holder". The note says that Apply holder checks the stored tool.
- The cache rule does not change. The memo key already holds the stored tool, so a still frame builds nothing. The `tool_library_preview` counter tests pass.

The two regression tests (in `tool_library_assembly.rs`). Each test failed before the fix and passes after it:
- `the_refusal_judges_the_stored_tool_not_shorter_draft_flutes`: stored flutes 15 mm, draft flutes 5 mm, ER20 chuck at projection 10. The group shows "Apply holder refuses this", and Apply holder refuses. Before the fix, the refusal was empty.
- `longer_draft_flutes_give_a_draft_note_not_an_apply_refusal`: draft flutes 25 mm, projection 20. The group shows no refusal and shows the draft note. Apply holder lands the holder. Before the fix, the model gave a false refusal.

The gate (macOS, head `9af86ad9f`):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 18 steps, 18 ok, 0 failed, 0 stalled. ui lib: 1615 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0.
- The head merges cleanly with origin/main.

The PR body has the new tests and this gate.

Ready for a re-check.

Clean review. No blocking findings remain. The PR is MERGEABLE.

Earlier finding:

1. **Fixed: judge the Apply holder refusal on the stored tool.** Commit `9af86ad9f` uses `Key::doc`, which reads the same stored tool as `editor_stored_tool()`. The unapplied draft gets a separate note. I checked the author's reply and both regression tests. Both passed locally in the complete UI lib suite:
   - `the_refusal_judges_the_stored_tool_not_shorter_draft_flutes`: the 10 mm projection refuses the stored 15 mm flutes despite the 5 mm draft flutes. Nothing lands.
   - `longer_draft_flutes_give_a_draft_note_not_an_apply_refusal`: the 20 mm projection accepts the stored 15 mm flutes despite the 25 mm draft flutes. The draft note shows, and Apply holder lands.

I read the complete PR diff and the fix diff. I checked the laws from current upstream/main, including `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`. The local trial merge is `055bb841a0c17065574d2ee1f6d747ab0e6a0359`. Its first parent is the PR head above. Its second parent is upstream/main `b13ebd440df1c1e422325b02a07df2c639ca5d68`.

What looks good:

- Apply holder uses the existing undoable command. Its validation remains in the command. The new preview check cannot replace collision checks or post checks.
- All seven assembly tests passed. They cover the earlier finding, undo, refusals, projection reseeding, and separate window drafts.
- The preview cache tests passed. A still frame builds no mesh.
- The before/after screenshot links load. I inspected both images. The after image shows the holder group and the 70 mm projection with a 130 mm total.
- The deferred surface changes remain recorded in the decision file and follow-up #3930.
